The Collins Cocktail
By: Night School
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:21pm

Ingredients




2 ounces spirit
3/4 ounce freshly squeezed lemon juice
3/4 ounce simple syrup
Garnish: lemon wedge and cherry on a pick

Preparation

1 In a pint mixing glass, add spirits and mixers 2 Fill glass with ice and shake vigorously for 6 seconds 3 Add soda to mixing glass and strain into Collins glass over fresh ice 4 Garnish
